about: Every Blunder and Mistake the owner (Lichess abustrup) made in his Lichess games up to 2026-10-16, one record each, for a trainer. Judgement = Lichess rule (win% drop >=15 Blunder, >=10 Mistake; mate rules as lila) applied to native Stockfish 19 evals; lichess_judgment = Lichess's own label where Lichess analysed the game. Evals are White point of view; win_pct_* are his point of view.

categories.allowed_short_mate: after his move the opponent has a forced mate in 3 or fewer (engine)
categories.hung_piece: the opponent's very next move (engine's best reply) is a capture and he stays 2+ points of material down after the exchange settles
categories.ignored_threat: the opponent already threatened something worth 15+ win% before his move (null-move probe), and the engine's best reply carries out that threat
categories.missed_short_mate: he had a forced mate in 3 or fewer and did not play it
categories.missed_free_material: the engine's best move is a capture that nets 2+ points more material than his move did
categories.allowed_longer_tactic: the reply line wins 2+ points of material within about 6 plies, or forces a mate longer than 3
categories.missed_own_tactic: his best line won 2+ points of material within about 6 plies (or a longer forced mate) and he missed it
categories.opening_positional: moves 1-12, none of the above: no material swing within the engine lines
categories.positional_or_endgame: after move 12, none of the above

research_category: research/2026-10-16 classifier (static exchange test only, no engine), kept for comparison with the population numbers
